{c_label}Cooldown:{/c}{c_resource} {if:SF_21}{c_resource}[SF_19]{/c}{else}{Cooldown Time}{/if}{/c} seconds
{if:SF_21}{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}[{Combat Effect Chance}|%|]{/c}
{/if}{/if}Make your stand, becoming {c_important}{u}Immune{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[{buffduration:JUG_INITIAL_INVULN}|1|]{/c} seconds and create a defensive area around you for {c_number}[SF_1|1|]{/c} seconds.

Standing in your {c_important}Fortress{/c} grants you and your allies {c_number}[SF_4]{/c} {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} stacks every {c_number}[SF_8|1|]{/c} seconds.
While inside of your {c_important}Fortress{/c} your Skills are free to Cast and you gain {c_number}[SF_18*100|1%x|]{/c} damage per stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.
While inside of {c_important}Fortress{/c} your Life cannot be reduced below {c_number}1{/c}.

Killing enemies inside of your {c_important}Fortress{/c} extends its duration by {c_number}[SF_13*1|1|]{/c} seconds up to {c_number}{SF_16}{/c} seconds.

You may recast {c_important}Fortress{/c} to move it to your current location.
Enemies inside {c_important}Fortress{/c} are Slowed by {c_number}[SF_13*100|%|]{/c} and take {c_number}[SF_15*100|%|]{/c} of your Thorns damage per second.
